files.text:
---
name: "nf-core/fastq_qc_trim_filter_setstrandedness"
description: "Performs linting, quality control, trimming, filtering, and strandedness\
  \ determination on RNA-seq FASTQ files, preparing them for downstream analysis."
keywords:
- "fastq"
- "rnaseq"
- "rrna"
- "trimming"
- "subsample"
- "strandedness"
components:
- "bbmap/bbsplit"
- "cat/fastq"
- "fastqc"
- "fq/lint"
- "fastq_remove_rrna"
- "fastq_subsample_fq_salmon"
- "fastq_fastqc_umitools_trimgalore"
- "fastq_fastqc_umitools_fastp"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel with input FastQ files. The meta map contains sample information,\n\
      e.g. [ id:'test' ].\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel with genome sequence in fasta format.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
- ch_transcript_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel with transcriptome sequence in fasta format.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
- ch_gtf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel with features in GTF format.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(gtf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gtf"
- ch_salmon_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing a Salmon index (optional).\n\nStructure: [\
      \ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- ch_sortmerna_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing a SortMeRNA index (optional).\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- ch_bowtie2_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing a Bowtie2 index for rRNA removal (optional).\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- ch_bbsplit_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Path to directory or tar.gz archive for a pre-built BBSplit index\
      \ (optional).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
    pattern: "{*,*.tar.gz}"
- ch_rrna_fastas:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing one or more FASTA files containing rRNA sequences\
      \ for use with\nSortMeRNA or Bowtie2 (optional).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
- skip_bbsplit:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to skip BBSplit for removal of non-reference genome reads"
- skip_fastqc:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to skip FastQC"
- skip_trimming:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to skip trimming"
- skip_umi_extract:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Skip the UMI extraction from the read in case the UMIs have been\
      \ moved to the headers in advance of the pipeline run"
- skip_linting:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to skip linting of FastQ files"
- make_salmon_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create salmon index before running salmon quant"
- make_sortmerna_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create sortmerna index before running sortmerna"
- make_bowtie2_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create bowtie2 index before running bowtie2 for rRNA\
      \ removal"
- trimmer:
    type: "string"
    description: "Specifies the trimming tool to use"
    enum:
    - "trimgalore"
    - "fastp"
- min_trimmed_reads:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Minimum number of trimmed reads below which samples are removed\
      \ from further processing"
- save_trimmed:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Save the trimmed FastQ files in the results directory?"
- fastp_merge:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "For FASTP, save merged fastqs stitching together read1 and read2\
      \ for paired end reads\n"
- remove_ribo_rna:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Enable the removal of reads derived from ribosomal RNA"
- ribo_removal_tool:
    type: "string"
    description: "Specifies the rRNA removal tool to use"
    enum:
    - "sortmerna"
    - "ribodetector"
    - "bowtie2"
- with_umi:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Enable UMI-based read deduplication"
- umi_discard_read:
    type: "integer"
    description: "After UMI barcode extraction discard either R1 or R2 by setting\
      \ this parameter to 1 or 2, respectively"
- save_merged_fastq:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Pass single-library samples through cat/fastq as well, so that merged\
      \ FastQ files\nare saved even when there is nothing to merge\n"
- stranded_threshold:
    type: "float"
    min: 0.5
    description: "The fraction of stranded reads that must be assigned to a strandedness\
      \ for confident assignment. Must be at least 0.5."
- unstranded_threshold:
    type: "float"
    description: "The difference in fraction of stranded reads assigned to 'forward'\
      \ and 'reverse' below which a sample is classified as 'unstranded'."
output:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Preprocessed FastQ reads, with the inferred strandedness added to\
      \ the meta map.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- reads_cat:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel snapshot of reads before adapter trimming.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- reads_trimmed:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel snapshot of reads after adapter trimming but before BBSplit/rRNA\
      \ removal.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- trim_read_count:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Number of reads remaining after trimming for all input samples.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), val(count) ]\n"
- trim_reads_merged:
    type: "file"
    description: "fastp's merged overlapping read pairs, produced only when `trimmer\
      \ == 'fastp'` and\n`fastp_merge == true`. Empty otherwise. These reads are excluded\
      \ from `reads`;\ncallers that want to use them downstream must consume this\
      \ channel separately.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(reads) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.merged.fastq.gz"
- multiqc_files:
    type: "file"
    description: "MultiQC-compatible output files from tools used in preprocessing,\
      \ one file per item.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(mqc) ]\n"
- lint_log_raw:
    type: "file"
    description: "fq lint log for the raw reads, only populated when linting is not\
      \ skipped.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- lint_log_trimmed:
    type: "file"
    description: "fq lint log for the trimmed reads, only populated when linting and\
      \ trimming are\nboth performed.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- lint_log_bbsplit:
    type: "file"
    description: "fq lint log for the reads after BBSplit, only populated when linting\
      \ is not skipped\nand BBSplit is run.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- lint_log_ribo:
    type: "file"
    description: "fq lint log for the reads after rRNA removal, only populated when\
      \ linting is not\nskipped and rRNA removal is run.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- fastqc_raw_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report for the raw reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(html)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_fastqc.html"
- fastqc_raw_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report archive for the raw reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(zip) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_fastqc.zip"
- fastqc_trim_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report for the trimmed reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(html) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_fastqc.html"
- fastqc_trim_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report archive for the trimmed reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(zip) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_fastqc.zip"
- trim_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastP trimming report, only populated when fastp is the trimmer.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(html) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastp.html"
- trim_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "Trim Galore! report archive. Reserved for the trimgalore path and\
      \ not currently\npopulated.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(zip) ] ]\n"
- trim_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Trimming report from FastP or Trim Galore!, depending on the trimmer.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(log) ] ]\n"
- trim_json:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastP trimming report in JSON format, only populated when fastp\
      \ is the trimmer.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(json) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastp.json"
- trim_unpaired:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQ files containing unpaired reads from read 1 or read 2, only\
      \ populated when\ntrimgalore is the trimmer.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*unpaired*.fq.gz"
- umi_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Logfile for umi_tools extract, only populated when UMI extraction\
      \ is performed.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- umi_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "UMI-extracted FastQ files, before trimming.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- bbsplit_stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "BBSplit statistics, only populated when BBSplit is run.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- sortmerna_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "SortMeRNA log file, only populated when sortmerna is the rRNA removal\
      \ tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- ribodetector_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "RiboDetector log file, only populated when ribodetector is the rRNA\
      \ removal tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- seqkit_stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "SeqKit statistics used to derive the mean read length for RiboDetector,\
      \ only\npopulated when ribodetector is the rRNA removal tool.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- bowtie2_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Bowtie2 alignment log files, only populated when bowtie2 is the\
      \ rRNA removal tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- bowtie2_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Bowtie2 index built from the rRNA references, only populated when\
      \ bowtie2 is the\nrRNA removal tool and make_bowtie2_index is true.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- fastqc_filtered_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report HTML files for filtered reads (after BBSplit and/or\
      \ rRNA removal).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(html) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.html"
- fastqc_filtered_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report ZIP files for filtered reads (after BBSplit and/or\
      \ rRNA removal).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(zip) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.zip"
- seqkit_prefixed:
    type: "file"
    description: "rRNA reference fasta files with their filename added as a prefix\
      \ to each sequence\nheader, only populated when a Bowtie2 index is built.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}{,.gz}"
- seqkit_converted:
    type: "file"
    description: "Prefixed rRNA reference fasta files with U bases converted to T,\
      \ only populated\nwhen a Bowtie2 index is built.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}{,.gz}"
- per_sample_mqc_bundle:
    type: "file"
    description: "Per-sample MultiQC-feeding outputs (FastQC raw/trim/filtered zips,\
      \ trim log/JSON,\nUMI log, BBSplit stats, SortMeRNA log, RiboDetector log, SeqKit\
      \ stats, Bowtie2\nlog) joined on meta.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(files)\
      \ ] ]\n"
authors:
- "@pinin4fjords"
maintainers:
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bbmap/bbsplit@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fastqc@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/cat/fastq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fq/lint@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fastq_remove_rrna@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fastq_subsample_fq_salmon@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fastq_fastqc_umitools_trimgalore@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fastq_fastqc_umitools_fastp@0.0.0-6d1763b"
